fullDescription: A high-contrast LeadFlow dashboard employing a Neubrutalist design system. It features bold typography, vibrant color blocks (Hot Pink, Mint, Canary, Lilac), and heavy 2px black borders. The layout uses a 240px sidebar and a bento-style grid for KPIs and data visualization. Ideal for SaaS dashboards, fintech platforms, or modern CRM tools requiring a high-energy, brutalist aesthetic. The UI utilizes the View Transition API for seamless state changes and prefetch hints for performance.
prompt:
## Resumo
A bold, Neubrutalist-inspired SaaS dashboard characterized by thick black borders, flat vibrant colors, hard shadows, and a distinct grid-based background. It combines editorial typography (Archivo Black) with technical mono-spacing for data points.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using a Neubrutalist aesthetic. **Colors**: Background #fdf9f0 (with 24px grid pattern in #111111 at 5% opacity), Primary #ff3d81, Success #3ddc97, Warning #ffd23f, Accent #c8a2ff, Danger #ff6b5e, Ink #111111. **Typography**: Headings use 'Archivo Black' (uppercase, tight tracking), body text uses 'Space Grotesk' (500/600/700 weights), and numeric data uses 'Space Mono'. **Components**: All cards/buttons must have a 2px solid #111111 border. **Shadows**: Use hard shadows with 0px blur: Small (4px 4px 0px 0px #111111), Medium (6px 6px 0px 0px #111111), Large (9px 9px 0px 0px #111111). **Interactions**: On hover, cards should translate(-2px, -2px) and increase shadow depth. On active/click, buttons should translate(2px, 2px) and shadow should go to 0px. **Global**: Border-radius for cards is 18px, buttons 8px, tags/nav-items 9999px.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation Sidebar
A 240px width sidebar. Top section features a logo with a #ff3d81 square icon (2px border). Navigation links use 100% width with 12px vertical padding. Active items are styled with a #ff3d81 background, 2px border, and 4px hard shadow. Bottom of sidebar contains a profile card (Neubrutal style) with user initials in a Lilac (#c8a2ff) box and a 'TEAM PLAN' tag in Canary (#ffd23f).

### Top Bar Header
A horizontal flex container. Left side: Page title in 36px Archivo Black (uppercase) and 18px subtitle. Right side: A search bar with a 2px border and internal icon; a 'Sync' button in Hot Pink (#ff3d81) with hard shadow; a notification bell with a Coral (#ff6b5e) dot indicator; and a circular user avatar in Mint (#3ddc97).

### KPI Grid
A 4-column grid of cards. Each card contains: 1) A 40px square icon container (colored #ff3d81, #ffd23f, #3ddc97, or #c8a2ff) with 2px border; 2) A percentage change pill (Mint background for up, Coral for down) in 10px Space Mono; 3) A large metric in 30px Archivo Black; 4) A label in medium-weight Space Grotesk.

### Analytics Section
A two-column layout (2/3 width and 1/3 width). The 2/3 column is a large chart card featuring an SVG bar chart with alternating Hot Pink and Lilac bars. The 1/3 column contains stacked vertical cards: a 'Lead Sources' donut chart using the primary palette and a 'Top Clients' list featuring horizontal progress bars with black-bordered containers.

### Recent Activity Table
A full-width neubrutalist card. Header is separated by a 2px black line. Table rows use 2px black dividers. Cells feature bold text for names, Space Mono for timestamps, and vibrant status pills (Mint for 'Completed', Lilac for 'Active', Canary for 'Pending', Coral for 'Error').

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Neubrutal Button — Actionable button with high-contrast borders and shadows.
HTML/CSS: `background: #ff3d81; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px #111111;` Transition: `all 0.1s ease`. Hover: `transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px 0px #111111;` Active: `transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 0px #111111;`

### Status Pill — Rounded indicator for data states.
A capsule-shaped pill (9999px radius). Padding: 4px 12px. Border: 2px solid #111111. Shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px #111111. Text: 12px bold. Colors: Success (#3ddc97), Pending (#ffd23f), Active (#c8a2ff), Error (#ff6b5e).

style.description: The style essence is 'Neubrutalism': high contrast and geometric. Typography pairs 'Archivo Black' (headings) with 'Space Grotesk' (body) and 'Space Mono' (data). Colors are saturated: Hot Pink (#ff3d81), Mint (#3ddc97), Canary (#ffd23f), Lilac (#c8a2ff), and Coral (#ff6b5e) set against a Cream Canvas (#fdf9f0). Elements use 2px solid black borders and 'hard shadows' (no blur) that shift on interaction.
